newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Monsanto buy repeated.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Monday she reiterated her buy rating on Monsanto Co.
-- Monsanto last week reported fourth quarter earnings from continuing operations were in line with Dain's expectations of $0.15 a share but a penny below Street expectations of $0.16.

-- Monsanto said growth initiatives, including acquisition-related expenditures, new product development and product launches, totaled roughly $900 million in 1996, or about $350 million more on a pretax basis than a year earlier.
-- Monsanto said growth initiatives are likely to be higher in 1997 due to planned acquisitions and several product introductions and launches in pharmaceuticals and agriculture.
-- The target price for the stock is $45 a share.
